QEVA DATA-AND-ENGINE BAG 0.5
================================

This BagIt payload preserves canonical mathematical records, protocol files,
the bounded engine, fixtures, source-rights metadata, and recovery verifiers.
It intentionally omits the v0.5 HTML/CSS/presentation layer and is not a full
website source tree. Do not run scripts/release.py or the Runtime/Preservation
verification tiers here; those belong to the complete outer release.

From this data/ directory, the supported recovery checks are:

  python3 -B scripts/verify.py --tier a
  node scripts/test_engine.mjs

Tier A verifies canonical records, schemas, revision chains, references,
relations, qualifications, and proof bindings. The Node fixture suite verifies
the exact pinned Mechanism Engine behavior. A future presentation should be a
new, explicitly versioned projection over these recovered records.
